name: Genealogies
overview: The genealogies recorded in Scripture, as exemplified in Matthew 1:1-6, trace the lineage of Jesus Christ from Abraham through King David, affirming His rightful place in the covenant promises and royal line. These records were carefully maintained as public registers to verify descent, such as proving priestly eligibility or tribal heritage, notably from Judah. While genealogies serve as an illustrative record of the saints in the book of life, Scripture also cautions against making them a subject of controversy or pride.
